$comment: Bloodbank NATS JetStream topology. Stream names are locked by ADR-0001; subject filters follow the Bloodbank Event Naming Contract — see bloodbank/docs/event-naming.md §3.

subject_conventions.$comment: Subjects carry no version token. A CloudEvents type is 4 tokens (bloodbank.<domain>.<entity>.<action>); the NATS subject prefixes the channel, making 5 (bloodbank.<channel>.<domain>.<entity>.<action>). Breaking payload changes get a new action or entity, not a version segment.

streams.name: BLOODBANK_EVENTS

notes: Replays preserve the original CloudEvents id and correlationid.
Replay metadata is added via NATS message headers, not by mutating the envelope.
See compose/nats/README.md for the full header contract.
Durable home for immutable CloudEvents traffic.
Consumed by projections, EventCatalog sync jobs, and service consumers via Dapr `bloodbank-pubsub`.

streams.name: BLOODBANK_COMMANDS

notes: Commands are intended to be handled once (workqueue retention).
Replies are short-lived correlation messages; they are not source-of-truth history.
Do not use this stream as a replay source for rebuilding projections.
Operational traffic only; covers commands (`bloodbank.cmd.>`) and replies (`bloodbank.rpy.>`).
Dead-letter handling is documented in README.md and will be implemented in V3-007, not here.
DLQ policy is deliberately out of scope for the scaffold wave.
V3-007 will add per-consumer dead-letter streams and document poison-message handling.
